children: South Korea’s imports rose 22.5% year-on-year to USD 63.51 billion in August 2026, slowing from a 26.5% surge in the prior month and missing market forecasts of 24.7%, flash data showed.
While marking the 10th consecutive month of import growth, the latest result pointed to the softest increase since May.
The slowdown reflected a moderation in domestic demand, although strong semiconductor-related imports continued to support overall trade activity.

title: South Korea Imports Rise Less than Estimated
